json_ld_descriptions:
AZ Legal (the customer-facing brand for Rowley Chapman & Barney, Ltd.) is a Mesa-based law firm serving clients across Arizona since 1987. Operating online at azlegal.com, the firm pairs nearly four decades of Arizona experience with modern accessibility — call-or-text the firm directly, free initial consultations, and a dedicated 24/7 criminal defense line. The firm's mission is to make life better for clients through honest, dedicated, and compassionate legal help delivered with clear, plain-language communication.

The firm provides comprehensive representation across key practice areas: personal injury, divorce and family law, criminal defense, estate planning, and probate. In personal injury, attorneys help clients pursue fair compensation for harms caused by accidents or negligence. Family law services address divorce, custody, and support matters with sensitivity to the stress these cases create. The criminal defense team brings practical insight to navigating Arizona's strict penalties, while the estate planning and probate teams guide clients in safeguarding assets, honoring wishes, and administering estates effectively.

Clients benefit from personalized attention and experienced counsel—values emphasized throughout the firm's approach. With nearly four decades of service to Mesa, the East Valley, and Arizona, the attorneys focus on transparent communication, keeping clients informed at every step. A defined process—initial consultation, case evaluation, and strategy development—ensures matters are handled methodically.

AZ Legal serves individuals, families, and businesses seeking practical, results-oriented legal solutions. Typical clients include injury victims and their families, people navigating divorce or post-decree issues, those facing criminal charges, and individuals planning or administering estates. The firm's geographic reach includes Mesa, the East Valley, and clients across Arizona who want responsive local counsel with statewide perspective.

The firm's credibility is underscored by its longevity and affiliations, including BBB Accreditation with an A+ rating, an AV Preeminent recognition for an attorney, and professional memberships such as WealthCounsel. These signals, combined with recognition in community publications, reflect a practice grounded in trusted advocacy, consistent values, and strong client relationships developed over nearly four decades.
